name: Medici Villas and Gardens in Tuscany
description: Scattered across the Tuscan countryside, these twelve villas and two gardens were the country retreats of the Medici, the Florentine banking dynasty, built between the 15th and 17th centuries. Unlike fortified castles or working farms, they were designed for leisure, art and learning, with terraced gardens opening onto the surrounding landscape. They became a model for royal and princely residences across Europe.
